author: LukeHole
quote: After over a decade of endless hype and countless delays, Grand Theft Auto VI is a massive disappointment that barely functions as a modern open-world game. Aside from the pretty graphics, almost every aspect of this title feels broken, outdated, or predatory. The mission design is suffocatingly rigid, handing you an instant failure screen the second you deviate from a strict, invisible script. Worse yet, the game is riddled with performance issues, jarring bugs, and clunky controls that make basic movement and shooting a chore. The writing completely lacks the sharp, fearless satire the franchise was built on, resulting in a boring, forgettable story.
